comparison.objective: Extract one terminal; record orients and packs two eggs small-end down.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated latch release versus shape-based reorientation, gentle grasping, and placement into tapered cups.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal removed with no connector damage or neighbor release versus two released, still eggs centered and correctly oriented in separate cups. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests fragile-object orientation and placement rather than release of a retained component.
